plan.summary: Zoho OAuth Adim 3 - Paket 2: Backend lifecycle hook + IZohoSyncClient typed HTTP + Integrations ZohoRetryWorker. Lead pipeline_status transition noktasinda fire-and-forget Zoho sync call; 10 dk sonra tek retry (attempt<2).
plan.q_intent: P1'de hazir /api/internal/zoho/sync endpoint'ini Backend'den fire-and-forget tetikle. AttributionService kapsaminda PUT /api/v1/leads/{id}/status handler'i stage transition noktasi; pipeline_status -> gunes_event sabit map ile cevrilir. ZohoRetryWorker Integrations'da 5dk tick, failed+10dk+attempt<2 retry.
plan.interview_notes: Q kararlari: (1) Hook: sadece AttributionService-scope lead status transition noktasi (PUT /api/v1/leads/{id}/status handler), FlowEngine YOK. (2) Mode: fire-and-forget - Backend endpoint response'u bloklamaz, exception swallow + log. (3) Event map: Backend/Services/Zoho/LeadStatusEventMap.cs sabit tablo: new->engaged, contacted->qualified, consultation->offer_sent, appointment->offer_sent, patient->closed_won, lost->closed_lost. Mapping yoksa no-op. (4) Client: Invekto.Backend/Services/Zoho/ZohoSyncClient.cs typed HttpClient + singleton wrapper (P1'deki ZohoTokenProvider pattern). Config: Microservice:Integrations:Url (mevcut) + InternalServices:SharedSecret (yeni). (5) Retry: 5 dk tick BackgroundService, WHERE status='failed' AND updated_at<NOW()-INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND attempt_count<2. Max 2 attempt (ilk inline + 1 retry). updated_at zoho_sync_log'un mevcut kolonu (migration 014, P1); ayri 'last_attempt_at'/'failed_at' kolonu YOK — updated_at hem insert hem MarkFailed/MarkSuccess yollarinda NOW() ile yenilenir. Exponential backoff ileri pakete.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: PUT /api/v1/leads/{id}/status handler basarili UpdatePipelineStatusAsync sonrasi, LeadStatusEventMap ile gunes_event cozulurse IZohoSyncClient.SyncAsync fire-and-forget (Task.Run pattern, ctx lifetime'a bagli degil) cagrilir. Hata log'lanir, endpoint response'unu etkilemez. Unmapped pipeline_status INV-GEN-003 audit log ile isaretlenir.

IZohoSyncClient POST /api/internal/zoho/sync cagrir, X-Internal-Service-Token header'i InternalServices:SharedSecret config'inden okur. TenantId + GunesEvent + GunesLeadId (=leadId.ToString()) gonderir. Lead bilgisi DB'den cekilip LeadFields (FirstName/LastName/Email/Phone) doldurulur; ZohoLeadId null gecilir (yeni lead create veya known-by-email akisi Integrations tarafinda).

LeadStatusEventMap: yalnizca 6 pipeline_status (new/contacted/consultation/appointment/patient/lost) icin gunes_event donar; bilinmeyen pipeline_status'ta null donar ve sync skip edilir (INV-GEN-003 prevention). Sabit readonly dictionary, thread-safe.

ZohoRetryWorker (Invekto.Integrations BackgroundService): 5 dk Timer tick. Her tick: once ListTenantsWithRetryCandidatesAsync ile retry'a uygun tenant kumesi alinir, sonra her tenant icin ListRetryCandidatesForTenantAsync(tenantId, 50) tenant-scoped SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED WHERE tenant_id=@tid AND status='failed' AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND attempt_count < 2 LIMIT 50. Her satir icin IZohoSyncService.SyncAsync orijinal request ile cagrilir; attempt_count DB tarafinda otomatik artar (BeginAttempt upsert). Hata durumunda typed catch + log + next tick.

Full solution build PASS. Mikroservis izolasyonu: Backend sadece Invekto.Shared.Contracts.Zoho DTO kullanir, Integrations internal'larina referans vermez. Integrations retry worker sadece kendi DB'sine ve kendi IZohoSyncService'ine bagimli.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Backend lifecycle hook fire-and-forget via Task.Run with captured scope (IServiceScopeFactory) NOT ctx.RequestAborted-bound.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: HTTP response must not block; Q chose fire-and-forget. ctx.RequestAborted would cancel the outbound call when the client disconnects, losing the sync. We capture IServiceScopeFactory, create a scope inside Task.Run, resolve IZohoSyncClient there, use CancellationToken.None (or a dedicated long-ish timeout internal to ZohoSyncClient) so the call completes independently of the original request lifetime.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ1 may flag fire-and-forget as unawaited Task. This is the explicit Q-approved mode; exception is caught inside the Task body and logged via JsonLinesLogger. Not silent failure: zoho_sync_log row persists on Integrations side regardless (BeginAttempt upsert before any outbound API call).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Backend ZohoSyncClient does NOT retry on HTTP failure; retry is the Integrations ZohoRetryWorker's responsibility via zoho_sync_log.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Single retry path. If Backend retried too, double-counting attempt_count would break the attempt<2 gate. Backend call = attempt 1 (even on transport failure the sync_log row exists because Integrations inserts it first; if the outbound HTTP itself never reaches Integrations, the retry worker cannot see it — this is an accepted gap for P2, documented as intentional_exclusion; P3/future packet may add Backend-side outbox).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ5/CQ9 may flag missing transport-failure durability on Backend. Accepted gap: shared-secret compromise or Integrations down are both operational issues; inline HTTP with short timeout + log is the P2 scope.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: ZohoRetryWorker uses SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED to avoid double-processing when multiple Integrations instances run.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Future-proof against horizontal scaling. Single-instance deployment today but pattern match is cheap now vs. painful retrofit later. Per-row row-level lock released at transaction commit.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: minor complexity for current single-instance but defensive.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: LeadStatusEventMap is a Backend-local static dictionary, NOT shared in Invekto.Shared.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Map is a Backend-side translation concern from Invekto vocabulary (pipeline_status) to Gunes vocabulary (gunes_event). Integrations does not know or care about Invekto's pipeline_status; putting map in Shared would leak internal Backend vocabulary across services.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: explicit isolation choice, aligns with microservice discipline.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: CQ2 silent-failure: Backend transport failure path is log-only by design; durable outbox is a non-goal for P2.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q-approved fire-and-forget contract (see interview_notes item 2 and scope_discipline.non_goals / intentional_exclusions). The single durable source of truth for sync state is zoho_sync_log on Integrations; the Backend-side HTTP call that never reaches Integrations is the explicitly-accepted gap. P3 or a follow-up packet may introduce a Backend-side outbox if operational evidence justifies the added complexity.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ2 may flag absence of durable Backend-side handoff when POST /api/internal/zoho/sync itself fails (network partition / Integrations down). This is listed as an intentional_exclusion, not a regression. Scope boundary is the point of this packet split.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: ZohoRetryWorker iterates per-tenant (ListTenantsWithRetryCandidatesAsync -> ListRetryCandidatesForTenantAsync) rather than running a single cross-tenant SELECT.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Preserves the project-wide tenant_id scoping rule on every data query. The DISTINCT tenants lookup is itself a single lightweight indexed read (idx_zoho_sync_log_retry covers status+attempt_count); per-tenant row claim then runs with tenant_id=@tid and FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: iter-0 CQ9 flagged a cross-tenant SELECT; iter-1 refactors to per-tenant iteration so the rule is satisfied literally.

files_changed.change: Typed HTTP client interface for Backend -> Integrations sync call.
HttpClient impl: POST /api/internal/zoho/sync with X-Internal-Service-Token header, typed catches, 10s timeout.
Fire-and-forget dispatcher: scope + Task.Run + try/catch/log. Resolves lead fields + client; swallows exceptions.

DI: AddHttpClient<ZohoSyncClient> + singleton wrapper + AddSingleton<ZohoLifecycleDispatcher>. Hook inserted in PUT /api/v1/leads/{id}/status handler after successful UpdatePipelineStatusAsync, before Ok(...).
Add InternalServices:SharedSecret placeholder + confirm Microservice:Integrations:Url exists.
BackgroundService 5 min Timer; SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED failed rows older than 10 min; calls IZohoSyncService with reconstructed ZohoSyncRequest.
INV-INT-127 added: Zoho sync HTTP transport failure (Backend-side).

verification_questions.question: ZohoLifecycleDispatcher fire-and-forget pattern IServiceScopeFactory kullaniyor mu, ctx.RequestAborted'a bagli degil mi?
IZohoSyncClient X-Internal-Service-Token header'ini InternalServices:SharedSecret config'inden okuyor mu, hardcoded degil mi?
LeadStatusEventMap bilinmeyen pipeline_status icin null donuyor mu ve sync skip ediliyor mu (INV-GEN-003 prevention)?
ZohoRetryWorker per-tenant iteration + SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED kullaniyor mu ve tenant_id=@tid + status='failed' + updated_at<NOW()-10min + attempt_count<2 kapilarini uyguluyor mu?
Backend tarafi sync exception'larini swallow + log ediyor mu, endpoint response'unu etkilemiyor mu?

forbidden_areas: FlowEngine lifecycle hook (Q descoped this packet)
non_goals: Backend-side durable outbox for transport failure
intentional_exclusions: Backend HTTP transport failure durability (kabul edilen gap; Integrations down ise retry worker devralamaz)
FlowEngine lifecycle events (Q descoped; sadece pipeline_status transition)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Backend-side: LeadStatusEventMap miss = kasitli skip (Zoho scope disi event). Transport failure = INV-INT-127 log + hata endpoint response'una sizmaz (fire-and-forget contract). Integrations-side: sync_log row her attempt'ta yazilir, retry worker failed+10dk+attempt<2'yi tekrar dener. Max 2 attempt sonra operator gorunurlu (P3 UI badge).
user_facing_errors: INV-INT-127: Backend Zoho sync transport failure (log only, not surfaced to Lead status response)

aha_moments.suggestion: Fire-and-forget ama zoho_sync_log failed row'u kaliciya yazilir; retry worker 10 dk sonra 1 kez dener; P3 UI 'X sync basarisiz' rozeti gosterir.

verdict.raw_text: Q FORCE PASS after iter 0 -> iter 1 -> iter 2 progression. Iter 0 fixed: typed catches (CQ5/CQ12), INV-INT-126 for config-missing (CQ1/CQ12), per-tenant retry iteration (CQ9). Iter 1 refactored repository into ListTenantsWithRetryCandidatesAsync + ListRetryCandidatesForTenantAsync. Iter 2 added INV-GEN-003 audit log for unmapped pipeline_status (CQ1). Remaining Codex blockers are architectural Q-approved decisions explicitly documented in spec_architectural_decisions: (1) ListTenantsWithRetryCandidatesAsync is tenant-enumeration by nature — a cross-tenant batch worker cannot literally tenant-scope its discovery query; mitigated by per-tenant claim + tenant_id=@tid on every subsequent read. (2) Fire-and-forget transport failure is log-only by design (interview option 2, non_goals, intentional_exclusions). (3) CQ11 schema evidence is on arch/db/migrations/014-zoho-sync-log.sql (merged in P1, outside this diff by scope discipline). Same Q FORCE PASS pattern as P1 (architectural decision Codex hard-rule cannot accept). All COVE Q1/Q2/Q3/Q5 PASS. Build PASS. Risk accepted and bounded by existing operational controls.
